subject: Renewal & expansion: premium SLA + throughput uplift (pilot rollout)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>

Subject: Renewal & expansion: premium SLA + throughput uplift (pilot rollout)

Hi Clara / LumenPay team,

Happy new year — hope you had a restful break. Our renewal for Q1 is coming up (term ends 2028-02-15) and I wanted to outline a renewal + expansion path that meets the latency and capacity targets you requested in December. High-level proposal below, happy to walk through with Procurement and Infra.

What we propose
- Premium SLA addendum: 99.95% platform availability for dedicated inference endpoints; 95th pct latency target of 150ms for the pinned model in the steady-state; 99.9th pct tail target of 500ms with documented mitigation steps.
- Reserved capacity uplift: convert your current shared tier to a 4-GPU reserved pool (mix of A10s), with burst access to additional GPUs during scheduled spikes.
- Pilot rollout: 3-week staging pilot (can be staged on your dev cluster) to validate latency and KV cache behavior, followed by a 30-day ramp in production.
- Commercial ask: ~15% MRR uplift for reserved capacity + a one-time onboarding credit (we can discuss exact numbers).

Attached: renewal-summary.pdf (proposal snapshot) and capacity-plan.xlsx (timeline + infra changes).

Next steps
1) Would you like us to produce a formal SLA addendum and DocuSign-ready amendment?
2) Can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week with Procurement + Infra for timeline and legal review?

Risk notes
- Model versioning: we'll provide pinned model hashes and a rollback playbook.
- Quality: if you see quality drift we will enable automatic fallback to baseline model variant and open an incident-driven analysis.

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben and Monica on pricing details once you confirm interest.

—
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: renewal-summary.pdf (PDF), capacity-plan.xlsx (Excel)

Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion: premium SLA + throughput uplift (pilot rollout)

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick asks before we pull Procurement in:  

- Can you provide a line-item breakdown of the 15% uplift (reserved GPU cost vs SLA premium vs onboarding)? We need this to model spend to our CFO.
- For the pilot: can you spell out the success criteria (p95, p99, error budget consumption) and the rollback trigger thresholds?
- Legal will need the SLA addendum to review; Procurement (cc’d) prefers DocuSign-ready docs.

On quality: we had a single incident in December where tail latency spiked during a synthetic test. We’d like the pilot to include a replay test with our production traffic profile.

If you can share a proposed timeline and draft addendum I’ll route to Priya and Infra for the sync.

Clara — thanks, great questions. Attached is a draft SLO addendum (slo-addendum-draft.docx) and a detailed pilot checklist. Summary answers below:  

Commercial breakout (example monthly delta)
- Reserved capacity premium (4-GPU pool): $12,000/mo
- SLA availability premium & support uplift: $1,800/mo
- One-time onboarding & testing credit (negotiable): $6,000
- Example net uplift: ~$15,800/mo (we can convert to committed TCV or monthly billing as you prefer).

Pilot success criteria (what we’ll measure)
- p95 latency <= 150ms for production-shaped replay over a 7-day window
- p99 latency <= 400ms for the same window
- Error budget consumption < 2% for the pilot period
- No more than one unplanned incident >15 minutes during the validation window

Rollback triggers
- p95 breach >20% for 3 consecutive measurement intervals
- p99 breach >50% with error budget >5%

Pilot timeline (proposed)
- Week 0: confirm scope + legal review
- Week 1: staging rollout + replay test (Infra-led)
- Week 2: production shadow + monitoring validation
- Week 3: smoke test and go/no-go for full traffic ramp

Links: pilot runbook and measurement dashboard (shared folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C

I’ve attached slo-addendum-draft.docx for Legal/Procurement to review. If you want, we can also prepare a DocuSign package and a line-item quote for Finance.

—
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
